description: Unit tests for TrustStoreMac component, testing certificate issuer retrieval and trust evaluation on macOS platform, including interaction with system keychains and platform trust evaluation APIs.

classes.name: DebugData
classes.description: A class for attaching debug data to base::SupportsUserData.

classes.name: TrustStoreMacImplTest
classes.description: Parameterized test fixture for TrustStoreMac, testing different trust implementation types and feature configurations.

methods.name: ReadTestCert
methods.description: Reads a PEM-encoded test certificate from file and parses it into a ParsedCertificate object.

methods.name: ParsedCertificateListAsDER
methods.description: Converts a list of ParsedCertificate objects to a vector of their DER-encoded strings.

methods.name: ParseFindCertificateOutputToDerCerts
methods.description: Parses the output of 'security find-certificate' command to extract DER-encoded certificates.

methods.name: TrustStoreMacImplTest::GetImplParam
methods.description: Retrieves the current parameter for the trust implementation type.

methods.name: TrustStoreMacImplTest::ExpectedTrustForAnchor
methods.description: Returns the expected CertificateTrust configuration for trust anchors based on test parameters.
